description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Sargent & Lundy is hiring an Operations Specialist 1 – Data Analytics/Power Platform Developer to support business operations through reporting, data analytics, and operational tools. The role develops and maintains Power Platform applications, analyzes data, and collaborates with management and internal teams to automate processes and meet business needs.
Power Platform application developer automating business processes, analyzing operational data, and producing metrics and reports

Responsibilities:
• Designing, developing, and rigorously testing high-quality applications aimed at automating core business processes
• Leveraging your knowledge of MS PowerApps to assist team members with application development
• Managing project timelines and regularly providing updates to the project manager regarding progress toward automation objectives
• Ensuring compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) and Citizen Developer guidelines to encourage best practices throughout the development lifecycle
• Implementing effective exception handling, metric reporting, global variables, and other best practices within solutions
• Supporting business operations by organizing internal databases and resources, facilitating meetings, and conducting data analysis and metric tracking
• Compiling supporting documentation to fulfill business group needs
• Analyzing data and generating reports to aid in project monitoring and decision-making
• Clearly communicating estimates, planning, and managing your workload along with progress updates
• Regularly engaging with management and stakeholders

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Business Management, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or Software Engineering. Other relevant technical degrees may also be considered
• Familiarity with Software Development Lifecycle Management
• Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with a proven ability to interact with and manage relationships among project team members, clients, and vendors at various levels
• A proactive approach to learning new skills and enhancing knowledge to contribute effectively to team operations
• A commitment to delivering high-quality, accurate deliverables with meticulous attention to detail
• Proficient in MS Office applications, particularly advanced skills in MS Excel and/or MS Access for creating detailed, interactive spreadsheets, workbooks, and databases

Preferred:
• Proficiency in Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Automate, Dataverse, and other related M365 tools is preferred
• hands-on experience with MS Power Apps and other applications within the Power Platform ecosystem is preferred
